title: Cherry Wood Tools 🌸
description: A resourcepack that changes wooden tools to be visually made out of cherry wood.
body:
# Wood Tools -> 🌸 Cherry Wood Tools 🌸

A Minecraft resourcepack to make your wooden tools as cute as they deserve to be.

Even if the poor things get used as fuel five minutes later. 💔

### Description;

A Minecraft resourcepack that changes wooden tools to be visually made out of cherry wood.![Textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7a7387cd76f08a26efd5ffbfb4b46de79642c66e.png)


### Other Info;

Dependencies-

No hard mod requirements.

No soft mod requirements.


Version-

Revision 0 - Minecraft 26.1+

My packs are default released for latest version of Minecraft- if you want it ported to a newer or older version let me know. _(*Done at my discretion. Some things may be too difficult to port.)_
